chunks: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Khalid, from his father, from Giyas, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
Indeed, the Commander of the Faithful (peace be upon him) disliked that the animals be given wine to drink.

key_terms.أَمِيرَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ: Commander of the Faithful (title for Imam Ali)

ai.seo_question: Did Imam Ali dislike giving wine to animals?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi records that Imam Ali (peace be upon him) disliked giving wine to animals, establishing an ethical preference for the consumption of intoxicants by livestock. This reflects the broader Shia jurisprudential principle of extending the moral and spiritual effects of *khamr* (intoxicants) beyond human consumption to animals, emphasizing their well-being and dignity. The narration highlights the practical application of the Commander of the Faithful's asceticism and attention to detail in daily life.

en.hubeali: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Khalid, from his father, from Giyas,
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said that Amir Al-Momineen<sup>asws</sup> abhorred that one should quench the wine to the animals’.
en.sarwar: 7. A number of our people have narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Khalid from his father from Ghiyath who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said that ’Amir al-Mu’minin, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, disliked one’s making the animals drink wine.’”
